ei.title: Chapter 4-11: Why Teens Delete Unpopular Social Media Posts
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have discovered one peculiar behaviour in particular that sets them apart — teenagers will post or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too low, they'll delete the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to earn recognition for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance. If the recognition is insufficient, they'd rather delete the content than suffer perceived judgement from others against their failed efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a negative effect on their self-esteem.

questions.passage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have discovered one (A)[peculiar / ordinary] behaviour in particular that sets them apart — teenagers will post or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too low, they'll delete the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to earn (B)[recognition / criticism] for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance. If the recognition is insufficient, they'd rather delete the content than suffer perceived judgement from others against their failed efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a (C)[negative / positive] effect on their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 특이한 행동, 인정을 얻기 위해, 부정적인 영향
det.analysis:
✅ ① peculiar — recognition — negative — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② ordinary — recognition — negative (A 반대: 특이한→평범한)
❌ ③ peculiar — criticism — negative (B 반대: 인정→비판)
❌ ④ peculiar — recognition — positive (C 반대: 부정적인→긍정적인)

questions.passage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have discovered one peculiar behaviour in particular that sets them apart — teenagers will post or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to (A)[gauge / overlook] the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too low, they'll (B)[delete / preserve] the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to earn recognition for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance. If the recognition is (C)[insufficient / abundant], they'd rather delete the content than suffer perceived judgement from others against their failed efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a negative effect on their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 반응의 양을 측정하고, 콘텐츠를 삭제하며, 인정이 불충분하면
det.analysis:
❌ ① overlook — delete — insufficient (A 반대: 측정하다→간과하다)
❌ ② gauge — preserve — insufficient (B 반대: 삭제하다→보존하다)
✅ ③ gauge — delete — insufficient — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ gauge — delete — abundant (C 반대: 불충분한→풍부한)

questions.passage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have (A)[discovered / concealed] one peculiar behaviour in particular that sets them apart — teenagers will post or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too low, they'll delete the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to (B)[earn / lose] recognition for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance. If the recognition is insufficient, they'd rather delete the content than suffer perceived judgement from others against their (C)[failed / successful] efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a negative effect on their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 연구가 발견했고, 인정을 얻기 위해, 실패한 노력에 대한 판단
det.analysis:
❌ ① concealed — earn — failed (A 반대: 발견했다→숨겼다)
✅ ② discovered — earn — failed — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ discovered — lose — failed (B 반대: 얻다→잃다)
❌ ④ discovered — earn — successful (C 반대: 실패한→성공한)

questions.passage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have discovered one ①<u>peculiar</u> behaviour in particular that sets them apart — teenagers will post or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too ②<u>low</u>, they'll delete the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to earn ③<u>neglect</u> for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance. If the recognition is insufficient, they'd rather delete the content than suffer perceived judgement from others against their failed efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a ④<u>negative</u> effect on their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean:
① peculiar(특이한) ✅ 맥락 적절 — 십대의 독특한 행동
② low(낮은) ✅ 맥락 적절 — 좋아요 수가 너무 적으면
③ neglect(무시) ❌ → recognition(인정)이 원문 — 게시 목적은 인정을 얻기 위함
④ negative(부정적인) ✅ 맥락 적절 — 자존감에 부정적 영향
det.analysis:
① peculiar(특이한): 십대의 독특한 SNS 행동을 묘사 — 적절 ✅
② low(낮은): 좋아요/공유 수가 너무 낮으면 삭제 — 적절 ✅
③ neglect(무시): 원문은 recognition(인정). 게시 목적이 '무시를 얻기 위해'는 문맥상 부적절 ←정답
④ negative(부정적인): 반응 없음이 자존감에 부정적 영향 — 적절 ✅

questions.passage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have ①<u>discovered</u> one peculiar behaviour in particular that sets them apart — teenagers will post or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too low, they'll ②<u>delete</u> the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to ③<u>earn</u> recognition for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance. If the recognition is insufficient, they'd rather delete the content than suffer perceived judgement from others against their failed efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a ④<u>beneficial</u> effect on their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean:
① discovered(발견했다) ✅ 연구가 행동을 발견
② delete(삭제하다) ✅ 콘텐츠를 삭제
③ earn(얻다) ✅ 인정을 얻기 위해
④ beneficial(유익한) ❌ → negative(부정적인)이 원문 — 반응 없음이 자존감에 유익한 영향은 문맥상 부적절
det.analysis:
① discovered(발견했다): 관찰 연구가 행동을 발견 — 적절 ✅
② delete(삭제하다): 좋아요 적으면 콘텐츠 삭제 — 적절 ✅
③ earn(얻다): 공유의 인정을 얻기 위해 — 적절 ✅
④ beneficial(유익한): 원문은 negative(부정적인). 반응 못 받는 것이 자존감에 '유익한' 영향은 부적절 ←정답

questions.passage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have discovered one peculiar behaviour in particular that sets them apart — teenagers will post or ①<u>share</u> something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too ②<u>high</u>, they'll delete the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to earn recognition for what they're sharing as a way to ③<u>self-enhance</u>. If the recognition is insufficient, they'd rather delete the content than suffer ④<u>perceived</u> judgement from others against their failed efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a negative effect on their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean:
① share(공유하다) ✅ SNS에 게시하거나 공유
② high(높은) ❌ → low(낮은)가 원문 — 좋아요 수가 너무 '높으면' 삭제한다는 것은 문맥상 부적절
③ self-enhance(자기를 높이다) ✅ 자기 고양의 수단
④ perceived(인지된) ✅ 인지된 판단을 겪는 것
det.analysis:
① share(공유하다): SNS에 무언가를 게시하거나 공유 — 적절 ✅
② high(높은): 원문은 low(낮은). 좋아요 수가 너무 '높으면' 콘텐츠를 삭제한다는 것은 논리적으로 모순 ←정답
③ self-enhance(자기를 높이다): 인정을 얻어 자기를 고양하는 수단 — 적절 ✅
④ perceived(인지된): 타인의 인지된 판단을 겪느니 차라리 삭제 — 적절 ✅
det.tip: low(낮은) ↔ high(높은). 문맥: 좋아요가 적을 때 삭제하는 것이 핵심

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 반응의 양을 측정하기 위해 게시물을 감시한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① reactions(반응): 좋아요와 공유 등 반응의 양을 측정 — 문맥 일치 ←정답
❌ ② opinions(의견): 양을 측정한다는 맥락에 부합하지 않음
❌ ③ comments(댓글): 본문은 Likes/Shares를 언급하며 댓글은 언급 없음
❌ ④ followers(팔로워): 게시물 자체의 반응이지 팔로워 수가 아님
det.tip: volume of reactions = 반응의 양 (좋아요, 공유 수)

det.analysis:
❌ ① increase(증가시키다): 반응 양을 '증가시키기 위해' 감시한다는 것은 문맥 부적절
❌ ② ignore(무시하다): 감시하면서 '무시하기 위해'는 모순
❌ ③ display(전시하다): 반응을 '전시하기 위해'는 목적이 다름
✅ ④ gauge(측정하다): 반응의 양을 측정/판단하기 위해 감시 — 문맥 일치 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 인지된 판단을 겪느니 차라리 콘텐츠를 삭제한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① welcome(환영하다): 판단을 환영한다면 삭제할 이유 없음
❌ ② avoid(피하다): 의미상 가능하나 원문은 'rather delete than suffer'로 suffer가 원문
✅ ③ suffer(겪다): 인지된 판단을 겪느니 차라리 삭제 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ express(표현하다): 판단을 표현한다는 것은 문맥 부적절
det.tip: suffer perceived judgement = 인지된 판단(비판)을 겪다

det.analysis:

❌ ③ regular(규칙적인, 보통의): 특이한과 반대 의미

det.analysis:

det.korean: perceived = 인식된, 인지된
det.analysis:
❌ ① actual(실제의): perceived는 '인지된'으로, 실제와 구분되는 개념
❌ ② expected(예상된): 인지와 예상은 다른 개념
✅ ③ recognized(인식된): perceived와 동의어 — 인지된, 인식된 ←정답
❌ ④ intended(의도된): 의도와 인지는 다른 개념

det.korean: insufficient = 불충분한 ↔ adequate = 충분한
det.analysis:
❌ ① limited(제한된): 불충분과 유사한 방향
❌ ② partial(부분적인): 불충분과 유사한 방향
❌ ③ moderate(적당한): 양극 사이의 중간이지 반의어 아님
✅ ④ adequate(충분한, 적절한): insufficient의 반의어 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 negative와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: negative = 부정적인 ↔ positive = 긍정적인
det.analysis:
❌ ① harmful(해로운): negative와 유사한 의미
✅ ② positive(긍정적인): negative의 정반대 ←정답
❌ ③ destructive(파괴적인): negative와 유사한 부정 방향
❌ ④ neutral(중립적인): 부정의 반대가 아니라 중간. 의미축이 다름

questions.passage:
(A) Teenagers will <u>post</u> or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions.

(B) The guard stood at his <u>post</u> near the main entrance throughout the entire night shift.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 post의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) post = SNS에 게시하다 / (B) post = 근무 위치, 직위
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 게시하다 — (B) 위치, 직위: (A)는 SNS에 콘텐츠를 올리는 의미, (B)는 경비원의 근무 위치 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 보내다 — (B) 기둥: (A)는 우편 보내다 의미로 SNS 맥락 부적절
❌ ③ (A) 공유하다 — (B) 우편물: (A)는 share가 아닌 post, (B)는 우편물이 아닌 근무 위치
❌ ④ (A) 올리다 — (B) 뒤쪽의: (B)의 뒤쪽의는 post의 의미 아님
det.tip: post: 게시하다(SNS) / 우편(물) / 직위, 근무지 / 기둥

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to observe and check the progress or quality of something over a period of time"

det.korean: 일정 기간 동안 무언가의 진행이나 질을 관찰하고 확인하다 = monitor(감시하다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① delete(삭제하다): 관찰이 아닌 제거
❌ ② discover(발견하다): 새로 알아내는 것이지 지속적 관찰 아님
✅ ③ monitor(감시하다): 진행/질을 관찰하고 확인 — 정의 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ perceive(인식하다): 인지하는 것이지 지속적 확인 아님
det.tip: monitor = observe, watch, check (감시하다, 추적 관찰하다)

questions.passage: Their aim of posting is to earn __________ (recognize) for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: recognize(동사: 인정하다) → recognition(명사: 인정)
det.analysis: to earn 뒤에 목적어(명사)가 필요. recognize(동사) → recognition(명사)으로 어형 변환. 'earn recognition' = 인정을 얻다

questions.passage: Not getting a reaction has a __________ (negate) effect on their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: negate(동사: 부정하다) → negative(형용사: 부정적인)
det.analysis: 관사 a와 명사 effect 사이에 형용사가 필요. negate(동사) → negative(형용사)로 어형 변환. 'a negative effect' = 부정적인 영향
det.tip: negate(v. 부정하다) → negative(adj. 부정적인) → negation(n. 부정)

questions.passage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have discovered one peculiar behaviour in particular that sets them apart — teenagers will post or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too low, they'll delete the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to earn recognition for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance. If the recognition is insufficient, they'd rather delete the content than suffer perceived judgement from others against their failed efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a negative effect on their __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 반응을 얻지 못하면 자존감에 부정적 영향
det.analysis:
❌ ① self-control(자기 통제): 반응 부재가 통제력에 영향은 문맥 부적절
❌ ② self-interest(이기심): 이기심에 부정적 영향은 논리적으로 맞지 않음
❌ ③ self-awareness(자기 인식): 반응 없음이 인식에 부정적 영향은 문맥 약함
✅ ④ self-esteem(자존감): 인정을 못 받으면 자존감에 부정적 영향 — 문맥 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Observation studies of teenagers using social media have discovered one peculiar behaviour in particular that __________ — teenagers will post or share something on social media, but then they'll monitor the post to gauge the volume of reactions. After a set amount of time, if the number of resulting 'Likes' and 'Shares' is too low, they'll delete the content. Sometimes within the first ten minutes! Their aim of posting is to earn recognition for what they're sharing as a way to self-enhance. If the recognition is insufficient, they'd rather delete the content than suffer perceived judgement from others against their failed efforts to self-enhance. Not getting a reaction has a negative effect on their self-esteem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 십대를 구별 짓는 특이한 행동 하나를 발견했다
det.analysis:
❌ ① holds them back(그들을 억제하다): 발견된 행동이 억제한다는 맥락 아님
✅ ② sets them apart(그들을 구별 짓다): 십대를 다른 집단과 구별 짓는 특이한 행동 — 문맥 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ brings them together(그들을 모으다): 구별이 아닌 결합으로 반대 방향
❌ ④ takes them down(그들을 무너뜨리다): 파괴적 의미로 문맥 부적절
det.tip: set apart = distinguish = differentiate (구별하다, 두드러지게 하다)
